encounter.notes: ROUTE C. The extracted Harvester_Monstrous_Boss has the same straight-tail bind pose that made Lamia_A_Boss unusable for Ozara (ymin -3.91, normalised to a 0.594 x 0.377 x 2.0 pencil with the torso in the top quarter). Reconstructing from the plates sidesteps it, exactly as Ozara did.

side_plates.why: The gallery publishes no full-body left or right profile. view-02 and view-06 are three-quarters and view-09/view-10 are tail crops. Accepted rather than synthesised.

closeups.rejected_reason: 21.04% at scale 0.850 with col=-288.9 - the fit runs off the left edge of the plate. view-04 and view-11 returned an IDENTICAL fit to three decimal places, so they are near-duplicate frames.
Identical fit to view-04 (21.04%, scale 0.850, col=-288.9); same rejection.

5.44% - the lowest error measured on this subject, and DOUBLED. Zooming the overlay on the face shows two pairs of eyes and two tooth rows, offset down-left by about a third of a face height, plus a ghost horn crown offset up-right. Fifth confirmation on this project that a good width error is not evidence of correct registration.
15.74%; the overlay ghosts both right-hand arms out to the right of the real arms.
11.21%; the overlay ghosts the arms out to both sides.

reference.closeup_note: All six rejected on their overlays. Unlike Ozara, this head IS starved by that: the verified box spans v 0.815-1.0 of a 994 px subject and the FACE proper only v 0.83-0.88, so the face occupies roughly 50 px of the base plate. A straight-on orthographic head plate is the highest-value follow-up for this asset by a wide margin.

geometry.provenance: Tencent Hunyuan3D-2mv (fp16, 50 steps, octree 380, seed 12345) from the letterboxed view-01/view-03 plates (1057px square). Draft: 663,362 faces, 60.9s. Unlike Ozara, the two plates here agree on the tail as well as the body - the coil is in the same configuration in both - which makes this the cleanest opposed pair used on this project. Clay render accepted (build/xalvakka-c/clay-draft-sheet.jpg): four arms, horned skull, plated abdomen and spined dorsal ridge all resolved.
geometry.budget_note: 45,000 - the standard boss band. Decimation is 14.7x from 663,362; the subject's detail is surface relief rather than thin protrusions, so it survives.

regions.note: Box verified on a membership render before projection. Two placements were rejected first, and the diagnosis technique is worth reusing: rather than nudging one box and re-rendering, three ADJACENT bands were coloured at once (0.78-0.83, 0.83-0.88, 0.88-1.0) so the render says directly which band holds the face. It is v 0.83-0.88; the horns are 0.88-1.0 and the collar 0.78-0.83. That also corrected a misreading - the first two boxes DID contain the face, but the face is so small on this subject that at contact-sheet scale the claimed region looked like horns only. The shoulder detector works here for once, suggesting 0.8034 against the hand-set 0.815.
